answer_2.quote: We use the most straightforward metric: Accuracy.

answer_4.quote: To better understand the vulnerabilities of LLMs to vertical input compared to the human brain, we recruit three graduate-level students who are native English speakers to conduct experiments on four different datasets. Each student is presented with choices and required to select one, repeating this process twice—once before and once after the vertical input.
